description: Search live jobs in Germany, Austria and Switzerland that are posted in English and don't list German as a requirement. Ask for a role and a city, for example "data analyst jobs in Berlin", and get current openings with links to each job page on LolaNext. Jobs come mainly from company career pages and are updated daily. Some ads say German is a plus, so check each ad's requirements. Want to know which jobs fit you? You can get a free personal match score for your CV on lolanext.com.
